name: "Feast of the Departed Warriors" Score Sharing Event
description: The in-game "Feast of the Departed Warriors" event has begun~ Your opponents are waiting for their moment to strike. Time to rise to the challenge, Travelers~ Share screenshots of your Battle Chronicles in this post's comments from today to June 26 for a chance to win Primogems ×100!
